info.name: Libraro - Learner App
info.description: Learner-facing mobile app API: branch browsing, seat booking, learner login/account, attendance. Two groups: Public (device-type/device-id + X-API-KEY only) and Learner Account (adds Authorization: Bearer <learner_token> from /learner/login).

variable.description: Adjust to your local/served URL (no trailing slash).
Must match APP_API_KEY in .env (sent as X-API-KEY).
HMAC secret key matching APP_HMAC_SECRET in .env.

exec: var r = Math.random() * 16 | 0, v = c == 'x' ? r : (r & 0x3 | 0x8);

request.description: Learner profile update API. Supports updating name, email, mobile/phone, dob, father_name, address, and profile picture (add, update, or remove).
